en.headline: Labour Department lowers thresholds for heat stress at work warnings from Friday
en.dek: Two new trigger conditions will allow higher-level alerts to be issued more readily when temperatures reach extreme levels or an extreme heat special alert is in force.
body: The Labour Department announced on Thursday that an enhanced Heat Stress at Work Warning system will take effect from Friday, introducing two new conditions to improve responsiveness during abnormally high temperatures.

When the Hong Kong Observatory issues an Extremely Hot Weather special alert, an amber warning will be triggered immediately and thresholds for higher levels will be lowered. Separately, if measured temperatures generally across Hong Kong reach 35 degrees Celsius or above, the warning level will automatically rise by one tier — from amber to red, or red to black.

Commissioner for Labour Sam Hui said the changes followed public concern after only the lowest amber alert was issued during recent record heat. The department expects the refined system to issue red warnings on four to seven days and black warnings on one to two days in a typical year, based on past data.

zh.headline: 勞工處明日起優化工作暑熱警告 下調門檻及自動調高一級
zh.dek: 新增兩項觸發條件，當天文台發極端酷熱特別提示或全港多處氣溫達35度或以上時，可更早發出更高級別警告。
body: 勞工處今日宣布，由明日（28日）起進一步優化「工作暑熱警告」系統，加入兩項新觸發條件，以提升在異常高溫下的警示作用。
當天文台發出「極端酷熱天氣」特別提示時，系統會即時發出黃色警告，並降低觸發更高級別警告的監測門檻。另外，若全港多處地區實測氣溫達攝氏35度或以上，警告級別會自動上調一級，即黃色轉紅色，或紅色轉黑色。
勞工處處長許澤森表示，優化是因應本月初持續高溫期間僅發出最低級黃色警告而引起的社會關注。參考過去數據，優化後每年或有4至7日發出紅色警告、1至2日發出黑色警告。
